projects.title: FlowForge

category.en: AI Automation Compiler / Multi-Agent Safety Tool
category.ru: Компилятор автоматизации с ИИ / Инструмент безопасности мультиагентных систем

short_description.en: Multi-agent tool that turns plain-language automation ideas into safe, human-reviewable workflow blueprints and importable n8n JSON drafts.
short_description.de: Multi-Agenten-Werkzeug, das natürlichsprachliche Automatisierungsideen in sichere, prüfbare Workflow-Entwürfe und importierbare n8n-JSON-Entwürfe umwandelt.
short_description.ru: Мультиагентный инструмент, преобразующий идеи автоматизации на обычном языке в безопасные схемы процессов для проверки человеком и импортируемые черновики JSON для n8n.

projects.long_description: FlowForge is a non-executing safety and observability layer for AI automation prototypes. It guides users through vague requirements, routes requests through a multi-agent compiler, generates structured workflow blueprints, exposes safety decisions and agent traces, and can produce inactive n8n JSON drafts for human review.
projects.role: Product creator and full-stack developer responsible for the product concept, frontend experience, server-side compiler pipeline, agent orchestration, safety boundaries, and n8n draft generation.
highlights: Multi-agent compiler with guided clarification, routing, blueprint generation, and safety review.
Produces structured, non-executing automation blueprints with human approval gates and blocked actions.
Provides agent trace, provider fallback, risk, safety, and run observability information.
Generates inactive n8n JSON drafts with placeholder credentials and validation against unsafe side effects.
outcome_or_proof: Working application and public GitHub repository are available.
Generated n8n drafts can be copied, downloaded, and imported for further human review.
No production actions are executed by the application.
source_notes: Derived from the FlowForge repository and README.
